name: dumbbell-wrist-curl.html
instructions:
1. Grab a pair of dumbbells using a supinated grip (palms facing up) and sit down on the end of a flat bench.
2. Bending only at the wrists, let the dumbbells drop as far as possible. This is the starting position for the exercise.
3. Slowly curl the dumbbells towards your body using your wrists. Squeeze the forearm muscles at the top of the movement.
4. Pause, and then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
5. Repeat for desired reps.
